title: doctor accepts `gh auth token` as a GitHub credential, but run-epic's surface reads GITHUB_TOKEN only
body: doctor's github check reports ok when `gh auth token` answers, but the PR + CI close-out surface run-epic builds (pullRequestsForRun -> forge.ResolveToken) reads GITHUB_TOKEN only. On a repo whose close-out rule init declares, a machine with gh authed but no GITHUB_TOKEN passes doctor and is still refused by run-epic at startup. Tick 9sz's `ticfac run` is planned to fetch the token from gh, which closes the gap; until then doctor's ok is optimistic, and either doctor should name which source it found or run-epic should accept gh's answer.
